title: Case 047: Bedroom Window Repair Request
initial_request: Hello. can come and fix the window from the bedroom because it isn’t closing properly.Thank you!
overview: The tenant reported a bedroom window that would not close properly. The tenant initially also reported a blocked toilet, then clarified that their mother had fixed it and that only the window needed attention. Northbridge Lettings contacted the landlord, who said he had arranged a plumber to visit; the agency later assigned a maintenance provider and sent repeated appointment reminders. The request was placed on hold several times while awaiting updates. The landlord’s contractor ultimately confirmed the window repair was complete, and the task was completed without payment.
outcome: The landlord’s contractor confirmed the job was complete. The task was marked completed without payment.
